QUOTE: "Runtime, global: call `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free)` ... Compile time: enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` and supply `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` / `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO`"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names both a runtime pointer pair and a compile-time macro pair, but it never says they are mutually exclusive. It also says it can't tell which expansion wins in each configuration.
